outline:
介紹VBA 語言基本資料處理的概念，包含基本輸入與輸出、程式的流程控制、函數的應用等指令之撰寫、程式之編輯、編譯、聯絡與程式之執行，並發展一套應用程式。
This course introduces the basic data processes of EXCEL VBA language. They include input/output, program process control, application of functions, program editing and execution, and so on.
schedule:
1. Getting started with Excel VBA programming
2. Programming concepts
3. Communicating with your users
4. Putting it all together

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content: Students will develop an Excel VBA application to solve a practical data-processing or management problem. Generative AI tools may be used to assist with VBA code generation, debugging, explanation, and improvement. The activities emphasize hands-on programming, problem solving, and the integration of Excel, VBA, and AI tools.
flexible_learning.outcome: Students will complete and submit an Excel VBA application project. The project will be evaluated based on program functionality, VBA programming skills, problem-solving ability, and appropriate use of AI tools. Students should be able to demonstrate and explain their applications and key VBA codes.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: The flexible learning project accounts for 20% of the final course grade.

assessment:
Midterm Exam 40%
Final Exam 40%
Excel VBA Application Project 20%

Generative AI tools may be used to support programming, debugging, and problem solving; however, students are expected to understand, verify, and explain the VBA code used in their assignments and projects.
